Hi all — I’ve reviewed INV-2027-04-1123 and the payment records. The duplicate gross charge is €12,400; VAT at 21% is €2,592, which gives a net duplicate amount of €9,808. (Note: Elaine’s earlier message used a slightly different VAT rate — I confirmed the invoice used 21%.)

Options proposed (see attached spreadsheet for line-by-line math):
A) Invoice offset (recommended): apply a credit of €12,400 gross to the May invoice. VAT recorded on our side will be reversed and we will issue an accounting credit note showing the VAT reallocation. This avoids a bank refund and clears the balance in the next billing cycle.
B) Refund + credit note: issue a bank refund for €12,400 gross and publish a credit note for reconciliation. Refunds take longer and may incur payment fees.

VAT split recommendations (we can do either):
- Pro-rata by usage (default): allocate VAT between the two entities using the percentage of usage in April (attached usage export).
- Explicit amounts: allocate €1,450 VAT to Clearwave EU B.V. and €1,142 VAT to Clearwave UK Ltd (example split; please confirm).

Action items for Clearwave to confirm: 1) choose A or B above, 2) confirm VAT allocation method and provide any additional VAT IDs if different from those listed, 3) sign the adjustment memo once I populate it.

I attached credit_calculation_20270509.xlsx with both options filled in and a draft adjustment memo (PDF stub) for signature. If you confirm option A and the split, we can apply the offset by the next invoice cycle (target: May 20th).
